matches.rationale: Both identify mathematical inconsistency in Equation (2)/(3) regarding how ΔW is applied to modality-specific tokens. The ground truth notes ambiguous concatenation and matrix multiplication with semicolons; the finding identifies the left side showing ΔWx while the right side applies different ΔW_i to x^(m_i), which is the same underlying issue of invalid mathematical formulation.

Both identify incorrect scaling in the cross-attention equations (5)-(6). Ground truth notes scaling by √N_t (token length) instead of embedding dimension; finding notes scaling by √d when it should be √r (the rank after projection). Both capture the same issue of incorrect normalization factor in attention computation.

Both identify the frozen visual connector in Qwen2.5-VL creating unfair experimental comparison. Ground truth explains this restricts improvements and creates asymmetry versus other backbones; finding notes the frozen connector limitation is not clearly reflected in setup description, creating confusion about fair comparison.

Ground truth identifies MME scores above 900-1000 as severely misscaled (should be below 100). Finding pred_id 3 identifies AIR-Bench inconsistencies between tables, which is a different metric and different issue entirely.

Both identify overgeneralization of claims about consistent improvements. Ground truth notes abstract claims don't reflect heterogeneous outcomes; finding contrasts abstract's measured tone with Section 6's exaggerated claims of 'completely solves' and 'absolutely ensures', capturing the same distortion of evidence.
Ground truth specifically identifies removal/weakening of ethical considerations in Broader Impacts section. None of the findings mention ethical integrity, broader impacts, or bias/misuse risks.

Both identify inflated rhetoric in describing MokA's contribution. Ground truth notes conclusion uses 'ensuring' and inflated phrases despite being 'preliminary step'; finding identifies Related Work section using 'proudly', 'guarantees', 'unmatched', 'redefines' - both capture inappropriate promotional language overstating contribution.

Ground truth identifies Table 3 showing some baselines (Uni-modal LoRA, Multiple LoRA) occasionally outperforming MokA, suggesting selective reporting. Finding pred_id 3 discusses AIR-Bench inconsistencies between tables, which is about data integrity across tables, not baselines outperforming MokA.
Ground truth identifies fabricated references [1], [2], [35] with suspicious arXiv IDs and non-existent technical reports. None of the findings mention reference fabrication or citation issues.

Ground truth identifies contradiction between Introduction's claim of equal importance for cross-modal adaptation versus partial modality experiments showing text dominance. Finding pred_id 8 discusses the partial modality experiment setup being biased, but focuses on methodological flaw rather than the narrative inconsistency about equal importance.

Both identify the partial modality inference experiment as methodologically flawed because cross-attention is disabled when only one modality's tokens are used. Ground truth notes this biases evaluation against non-text modalities; finding notes this prevents proper evaluation of cross-modal interaction and undermines the empirical motivation.

Both identify inflated marketing-like language in Related Work section. Ground truth notes phrases like 'targeted solution for efficient and effective' overstate novelty; finding identifies 'proudly propose', 'unique and superior', 'boldly guarantees', 'unmatched' as inappropriately promotional language.

Ground truth identifies Table 6 understating computational overhead (1.069× vs. up to 21.3% in appendix tables). None of the findings discuss computational cost, forward time, or efficiency overhead misrepresentation.

Ground truth identifies inconsistency between Section 4.4's description of cross-attention variants (original keeps text unchanged vs. cross-attention* updates text). None of the findings discuss the cross-attention* variant or query/key role reversal confusion.

Ground truth identifies Equation (13) notation inconsistency where cross-modal text term is zero vector without B matrix multiplication, breaking uniform parameterization pattern. Finding pred_id 1 discusses Equation (2), and pred_id 2 discusses normalization, but neither addresses Equation (13)'s specific notation inconsistency.
